ValidationRule.description: Enforces that a Primary Contact is assigned via the Opportunity Contact Roles before the Opportunity can be moved into the 'Quotation Phase', unless bypassed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT(CONTAINS($Label.Validation_exempted_Users, $User.Username)), NOT(ISCHANGED(SkipValidations__c)),
ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Quotation Phase'), DecisionMakerContactRoleSetHelper__c = FALSE
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please assign the primary contact in the Opportunity Contact Roles!
